derivation: fixtures/machine_status.json. M1 DOWN days: 02, 03, 06, 08, 09, 10 (07 has no row). Number the DOWN days in date order 1..6 and subtract that number from the date: 02-1=01, 03-2=01, 06-3=03, 08-4=04, 09-5=04, 10-6=04. Equal keys form islands: {02,03}, {06}, {08,09,10}. The missing 07 splits 06 from 08. The last observed day in the whole table is 2026-03-10, so the island ending on 10 is open at the data end. M2 DOWN days: 01 and 05 -> keys 02-28 and 03-03 -> two one-day islands. The naive GROUP BY machine_id, status merges every DOWN day of M1 into one span 02..10 of 6 days, which is wrong.
